form.targetHint: Without a goal, the card shows only the balance. Reaching the goal does not block a deposit.

deactivate.title: Deactivate "{{name}}"?
deactivate.description: The saved balance keeps counting in the total and its history stays — what it stops accepting is new deposits and withdrawals. If the idea was to close it, withdraw the balance first.

activate.title: Reactivate "{{name}}"?
activate.description: The cashbox goes back to accepting deposits and withdrawals. Its balance and history do not change.

delete.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
delete.blockedDescription: The cashbox still has a balance. Deleting is only allowed with a zero balance — deactivate it instead, or withdraw the balance and try again.

empty.title: No cashboxes yet
empty.description: A cashbox sets aside money that is still in an account but already has a purpose — a vacation, renovations, an emergency fund. Saving is not spending, so none of it counts as an expense.

error.title: Could not load the cashboxes
error.description: Check your connection and try again.

language.heading: Language
language.description: Changes the whole interface's language, without reloading the page. The choice belongs to the account, not the browser — it survives logging out and back in.
language.label: Language
language.note: Português (Brasil) is the default. Numbers, dates and currency follow the chosen language.
language.error: Could not save. The language went back to {{locale}}.
